final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM counts), 0) AS share FROM counts), above_average AS (SELECT order_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(order_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_average
